name: NLM Clinical Tables Search Service — ICD-10-CM

usage.notes: Panacea uses the NLM Clinical Tables ICD-10-CM v3 endpoint only as an explicit fallback when the configured WHO ICD-11 path is unavailable or returns no usable result. The backend adapter bounds the query and requested result count; the UI must preserve the `icd10cm` source marker.

license.scope: NLM documents the Clinical Tables Search Service as open to the general public, free of charge and provided as-is, while also stating that individual datasets may carry their own terms of use. This entry therefore does not infer one blanket copyright or commercial-use permission from the service host alone.
license.notes: Before redistributing or building derivative terminology products, verify the exact ICD-10-CM dataset/source terms in effect for the intended use. Do not use NLM/NIH names to imply endorsement.

validation.notes: ICD-10-CM is a coding classification reference, not evidence that a diagnosis is correct for an individual patient. Panacea exposes this source only as a clearly labeled fallback and must not present an ICD-10-CM result as ICD-11.

provenance.authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine Clinical Tables Search Service serving ICD-10-CM
provenance.notes: Persist the source marker `icd10cm`, code, title and retrieval context. The current Clinical Tables v3 URL identifies the API contract but does not pin a specific ICD-10-CM data release in Panacea, so this source has weaker reproducibility than the explicitly pinned WHO ICD-11 path. Add release identity if the service exposes a stable dataset-version field suitable for storage.

adapter.notes: Implemented fallback: bounded/sanitized diagnosis term -> NLM Clinical Tables ICD-10-CM v3 -> defensive parsing of display rows -> IcdEntry with `sumber: icd10cm`. The same module owns WHO ICD-11 and NLM fallback routing so source identity remains explicit at the normalization boundary.
